requirements.text: Students should be able to search the library catalogue and check real-time availability of materials.
Students should be able to borrow, return, and renew items online.
Students should be able to book study rooms online by selecting dates, time slots, and room capacities.
Students should be able to view their current loans, due dates, and any associated fines or holds.
Students should receive automated reminders for due dates.
Students should have access to their reservation history.
Staff should have a streamlined way to manage the book inventory, including adding, updating, and retiring items, with categorization options for easier organization.
Staff should have access to detailed usage reports to track loan volumes, popular items, and study room utilization.
Staff should have tools to manage student accounts, including placing holds for students with outstanding fines.
Staff should have a dashboard for quick access to performance metrics like loan statistics, overdue items, and overall room usage.
The system must automatically calculate fines based on configurable daily rates for overdue items, without manual entry.
The system must allow easy adjustment of fine rates based on criteria such as item type or overdue duration.
Students should receive immediate notifications when fines are applied.
Students should be able to view their outstanding fines, including a breakdown of charges.
The system must flag accounts with outstanding fines above a certain threshold for easier management.
The system must integrate smoothly with the existing student record system to verify enrollment status before allowing loans or room bookings.
The system must comply with GDPR for handling student data, including borrowing and fine history.
The system must ensure data migration from the legacy system without any loss of existing loan and account information.
The system must be accessible on mobile devices and conform to accessibility standards.
The system must operate within budget constraints for cost-effective decisions.
